## Direct associated-bundle identity from the common-A action

The deciding expression is `aether_einstein_cartan_joint_pushforward_v15_75.
first_order_parent_action`, lines 32–35:

\[
S_5\supset \frac{K_{F5}}4\int W\operatorname{Tr}_{16}(F_A^2)
+S_{\rm Dirac}[e,\omega_{\rm spin},A,\Psi].
\]

v15.69 `unified_parent_boundary_functional` puts A5 and Psi5 in one
fixed-trace functional and extends the diagonal principal operator through
the rank16 carrier. The already-adopted v14.45 canonical action fixes the
meaning of its minimal covariant derivative; its normalized collar
pullback preserves that tangential derivative with coefficient one.
These are more than equality of trace norms.

On the associated bundle the prescription is

\[
\nabla^{\rm total}_5
=\nabla^{\rm spin}_5\otimes I_{16}\otimes I_3
+I_{\rm spin}\otimes\rho_{16*}(A_5)\otimes I_3,
\qquad A_5=\iota_*\omega_{\rm mech}+a_5.
\]

Here iota is the retained weak-group inclusion in the rank16 SM carrier,
not an injection of a k5 bare angular eigenspace. For associated sections
the connection-preserving equality is

\[
\nabla^{SM}_{\iota_*\omega}\mathcal I_\rho
=\mathcal I_\rho\nabla^{P_{\rm diag}}_\omega.
\]

The retained v17.97 sector sets the **fluctuation** a5 to zero around that
mechanical reference. This equation, the canonical common-A coupling and
the actual representation are used together; the zero-input flux graph
alone would not establish the coupling. No interpolation coefficient or
new state is selected. Hypercharge/color reference amplitudes are zero in
that declared classical reference; independent fluctuations and quantum
strong contributions are not thereby eliminated.

The spin connection acts on its own tensor factor and is already in D_geom.
Its Levi-Civita/contorsion split is distinct from omega_mech. At zero
classical Psi the algebraic contorsion current vanishes, without setting
quantum contacts to zero. Mechanical curvature energy stays owned by R8;
no duplicate classical energy is added, and that ownership does not remove
the minimal fermion coupling.

This fixes the direct effective M4 trace insertion. It does not evaluate
the full M5 wall elimination, spectral/completion response or source lift.
Those global calculations must use this prescription rather than treating
an absent builder as a new free physical coupling. The canonical adopted
fermion action is retained; no bosonic-to-Grassmann derivation is imposed.

## Same-field action identity

v15.39 defines one physical eta scalar f. v15.76 `shell_geometry` takes
the cap's f and explicitly inserts it in the v14.45 zero mode; v15.82
`regular_einstein_cartan_kernel` repeats that identification. On a compatible
oriented collar X(s,y) the same field therefore obeys

\[
 f_{\eta,c}=f_{\rm child}\circ X=\rho(X)/2,\qquad
 \boxed{m_{\eta,c}=-\tfrac12\rho_s\cot(\rho/2)}.               \tag{1}
\]

This is an action-producer field identification followed by restriction,
not a coordinate change equating distinct scalar reductions. The normal
action and mode are

\[
 D_{\perp,\epsilon}=i\epsilon\Gamma_\perp
 [\partial_s+\tfrac12\partial_s\log J_c+m_{\eta,c}],\quad
 u_c=N_cJ_c^{-1/2}\sin(f_{\rm child}\circ X),\quad
 N_c^{-2}=\int\sin^2(f_{\rm child}\circ X)ds.                  \tag{2}
\]

Unit normalization and the normal zero-mode identity do not select f.

rescaling or equality of normalized material/fermion densities is used.

## Derived operator

The retained charged-lepton action is composed with its certified metric
ds^2=-d_tau^2+R(tau)^2 dOmega_3^2. In the declared chiral convention the
metric-only equation is

    i (partial_tau + 3 dot(R)/(2R)) psi
       = [ diag(-D3,+D3)/R + mu_geom sigma1_LR tensor I ] psi.

The rescaling chi=R^(3/2) psi removes the spin-connection expansion term and
preserves the equal-time inner product/CAR:

    integral R^3 psi^dagger psi dOmega = integral chi^dagger chi dOmega
    H = R^-1 diag(-D3,+D3) + mu_geom sigma1_LR tensor I
    B_H = i partial_tau - H.

The standard round-S3 mode reduction and R^(-3/2) normalization are also
documented in [the closed-FLRW canonical fermion treatment, section 2](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10714-026-03613-3).
Only that classical mode construction is used here; its cosmological model
and quantum-geometry state are not imported into BHSM. Our S3 physical-volume
convention remains the retained 2*pi^2 R^3. The BHSM geometry and action
sources are frozen in input_hashes.json.

## Executable body and photon insertions

The saved spatial block has the established n=0 carrier and n=1 intermediate
space, including its spectator copy. In this fixed basis D3 has dimensions
10x10 and the chiral body has dimensions 20x20. The eight saved real photon
test modes give Hermitian current actions J_i. Their first-order source is

    B_H,a_i = Q diag(-J_i,+J_i)/sqrt(2*pi^2 R^3), Q=-1.

The volume factor and its inherited 73-direction geometry derivatives are
saved. They are not physical q=t*u soft-transfer derivatives. Gauge modes
remain spatially normalized test sources; no native photon residue or fitted
coupling is inserted. The external-only block is not closed under these
currents: the summed outgoing squared norm is 32, or strength 8 per external
LR/spin component. This requires the already saved n1 intermediate block.
It does not establish that all discarded modes vanish in the Pauli response.
